data.title: Binance Will Add TUSD Quote Pairs into the USDⓈ Trading Market/Tab
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance will open trading for BNB/TUSD, BTC/TUSD and ETH/TUSD trading pairs at 2019/03/13 4:00 AM (UTC) in the USDⓈ Trading Market/Tab.

Please note: The existing TUSD/BNB, TUSD/BTC and TUSD/ETH trading pairs will be removed and delisted at 2019/03/14 4:00 AM (UTC). All existing orders in each order book will also be canceled at this time.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2019/03/12

 

Find us on

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange

Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance
